name: feature.promotions.nodes
description: Promotions feature node pack (MERCH-B chat-drivability) — nodes over the ctx.features.promotions surface. `list-active` lists live promotions; `apply-preview` previews the discount on a hypothetical cart; `create` authors a promotion but — because promotions MOVE MONEY — an agent-authored promotion lands PROPOSED (active:false), a human activates it (the strategy/CDP 'agent proposes, human confirms' firewall). All role:'action' (recorded → replay-safe).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Promotions List Active
nodes.description: Lists the org's active promotions over ctx.features.promotions. role:'action' (recorded). Inputs: orgId.

nodes.label: Promotions Apply Preview
nodes.description: Previews the total discount + fired promotions on a hypothetical cart (does NOT create an order). Inputs: orgId, currency?, items:[{productId,unitPrice,quantity}].

nodes.label: Promotions Create (proposed)
nodes.description: Authors a promotion — agent-authored ⇒ PROPOSED (active:false); a human activates in the Promotions page (money-moving, so never auto-live). Inputs: orgId, name, type, reward:{kind,value}, minSpend?, budget?, scope?, segmentId?, priority?.
